title: Cooling units used with heating boilers.
officialText:
Boilers, where used in conjunction with refrigeration systems, shall be installed so
that the chilled medium is piped in parallel with the heating boiler with appropriate valves to prevent the chilled medium from
entering the heating boiler. Where hot water heating boilers are connected to heating coils located in air-handling units where they
might be exposed to refrigerated air circulation, such boiler piping systems shall be equipped with flow control valves or other
automatic means to prevent gravity circulation of the boiler water during the cooling cycle.
